add_crime_rate: add crime rate data for a zip code with violent and property crime rates
update_crime_rate: update violent or property crime rate for an existing zip code in the database
get_crime_rate: get crime rate data for a specific zip code from the rate-limited API
get_api_call_count: get the current API call count to track usage against the rate limit
get_api_call_limit: get the maximum API call limit for the free version of the service
